title: Native skip-transcoder MLP approximation fidelity
hypothesis: For the pinned SmolLM2-135M layer-8 MLP, the released 128x top-k skip-transcoder will reconstruct the original MLP output with held-out relative MSE <=0.10 and cosine >=0.95 while activating <=128 of 73,728 features; its serialized standalone payload cost will be reported against the native dense MLP.
physical_object: Pinned HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M layer-8 MLP plus its released skip-transcoder checkpoint.
mirror_coordinate: Native sparse latent activation vector (top-k 128); MA-533 evaluates whether this atom basis faithfully represents the original layer before adding any Mirror-view parameter.
logical_multiplicity: One MLP function expressed through sparse transcoder features; no multiplicity claim in this screen.
controls: Released transcoder skip + decoded sparse feature output
Truncated-SVD rank-128 projection fitted on development activations as a generic compression control

task.model_revision: resolved and recorded in source before evaluation
task.dataset: closji/wikitext__wikitext-2-raw-v1, train parquet, immutable revision d575192455c5e98b8daed777574046264579cb09; source is a public parquet mirror of Wikitext-2 raw.
primary_metrics: cosine similarity per token, then mean

development.selection_metric: single fixed checkpoint evaluation; no tuning or fresh-based selection
development.task_scope: Use 16 fixed-order seeded windows (2048 tokens) to fit the rank-128 linear control and 16 disjoint windows (2048 tokens) for evaluation; training split only.

fresh.access_condition: Open only if dev relative MSE <=0.10 and cosine >=0.95.

storage.serialization: safetensors raw checkpoint plus canonical JSON config and required adapter code; report incremental and standalone deployment bytes
paid_objects: method-specific serialized state and config for each control; report per-method incremental and standalone payload

compute.report_active_compute_proxy: Report dense encoder MACs, sparse decoder MACs, skip MACs and native MLP linear MACs separately; report isolated native and transcoder wall time.

success_gate: On each fresh seed, transcoder held-out relative MSE <=0.10 and mean token cosine >=0.95; report actual serialized bytes and latency. Passing establishes only this checkpoint/layer approximation, not Mirror benefit.
failure_gate: Development held-out relative MSE >0.10 or mean cosine <0.95; keep fresh sealed.
boundaries: Single released checkpoint, model and layer.
This screen establishes transcoder faithfulness only; it does not establish logical MLP multiplicity or Mirror-specific gains.
Test data must remain unopened until protocol and source commits are pushed.
CPU-constrained development uses 4,096 tokens; no broad generalization claim.

amendments.before_rerun: Initial development output was invalidated before interpretation after audit found incorrect skip matrix orientation and per-token norm scaling. Frozen implementation is corrected to match EleutherAI/sparsify SparseCoder.forward exactly: W_skip transpose, raw input, no output rescaling. Prior dev artifact is retained in runs/dev_initial_invalid/ as a non-result.
amendments.evidence: Official EleutherAI/sparsify source at commit resolved during audit; source URL https://github.com/EleutherAI/sparsify/blob/main/sparsify/sparse_coder.py (forward computes decode(...) + x @ W_skip.mT).

amendments.before_rerun: Original Salesforce dataset script is no longer served, so its loader raised 404 before evaluating any metrics. Use the immutable parquet mirror `closji/wikitext__wikitext-2-raw-v1` revision d575192455c5e98b8daed777574046264579cb09 with the same Wikitext-2 raw train split and window protocol. No test data opened.

amendments.before_metric_rerun: Audit found initial compute proxy counted sparse decoder MACs but omitted dense encoder and skip-connection MACs; it also timed full-model capture but not isolated sublayer inference. Final source reports all three operation proxies and isolated native/transcoder layer timings. Fidelity metric formula and split are unchanged.

amendments.before_final_result: The previous control byte column incorrectly reused transcoder bytes for skip-only and rank-128 controls. Each method now has its own serialized safetensors state and method config; both incremental and standalone payload sizes/hashes are reported. The quality metrics and data split are unchanged.

Compute rank-128 validation output using the exact factorized state stored in its serialized payload and report rank-control, skip-only, and native/transcoder inference wall times plus rank-control MACs.
